full: A full-body 2D anime fantasy game animation of a bard actively PLAYING her lute, a clear deliberate three-second musical skill performance. Start performing immediately. The adult female bard Ere keeps the exact original right-facing three-quarter pose. Her RIGHT FOREARM and RIGHT HAND are the main moving parts: she lifts the strumming wrist above the round sound hole, makes a clearly visible broad DOWNSTROKE across all the lute strings, then raises the wrist for an UPSTROKE and repeats THREE rhythmic down-up strums. The whole forearm swings from the elbow; the hand travels a full palm-width across the soundboard on every stroke. This is visible purposeful lute playing, not just breathing, not a frozen hand resting on the strings. Keep the strumming hand in front of the sound hole. Her LEFT HAND keeps supporting the same straight lute neck while the fingers make small chord changes. Her chest and shoulders follow the musical rhythm with a graceful rise and release, and her head gives a small expressive upward nod on the final strong strum. Her eyes remain softly closed and the original mouth remains narrow and softly open. Preserve the same mature face, long chestnut braid, embroidered black cap and sheer veil, ivory sleeves, burgundy and black layered skirt, gold star jewelry and brown boots. ONE wooden pear-shaped lute stays rigid, keeping its exact outline, sound hole, neck, strings and pegs. Her braid, veil, sleeve cuffs, skirt hems and lute ribbon follow the arm and torso motion with soft delay. Both boots stay planted in the exact same positions throughout. Upright posture, no stepping, no jumping, no dancing spin, no turning towards the camera. Fixed camera, no zoom, entire body and both boots always visible. No floating music notes, no magic, no glow, no particles, no text. Plain solid green background.
